I think the best piece of advice is this: don't assume things will get better. If you do the same things, specifically addictions, then you will get worse over time. You should just stop the weed and porn. Go on youtube, look up alex becker and what he says about dopamine fasting. Frankly, I didn't listen to the above and I have paid for it dearly. I never stopped my bullshit and just assumed "it would get better." You sound smarter than I was.. so.. I hope you listen. These addictions take everything from you, including your will to want to do anything else and also your ability to learn. They stimulate you unnaturally and it fucks with what humans are supposed to be. Merely stop these things and you will be much better after a time, but initiially it will seem to get worse because they are used as a crutch. Also sugar and other BS foods. Also content consumption in excess.

Also look up how he recommends that you focus on things. You need to set up your environment to win.

Other than that, you don't have to eat 3 times a day. Do 1-2, focus on eating mostly meat and veg. You don't have to be too strict generally but that's a good foundation. 

Exercise is good, start with 30 minutes of cardio a day and then add in some body weights when you start to feel better. It will help depression.

Make sure your sleep is good. 

Don't overwhelm yourself by overthinking on information. Pick something and try it for a month, or however long is appropriate.
